title: CPU-bounded Qwen3.5-35B-A3B AQ4_0 generation reclassification suite
shortening_rationale: The source-vs-AQ4_0 implementation streams all 40 decoder layers and selected expert rows on CPU. This three-case subset preserves Japanese prose, English prose, and code response coverage while limiting completions to 8-16 greedy tokens. It is explicitly not the full ten-case service promotion suite.
